pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...g6 4.e3 Bg7 5.Nbd2 O-O 6.Bd3 c5
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight Nbd2-f1-e3-e5 to a square the f3-knight reaches at once; plan 4 called the g5-bishop light-squared and said ...Nh5 forces its trade. Rewrote plans 1 and 4 (...h6 and ...Qb6 against b2). British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...Ne4 4.Bf4
pages.notes: Plan 1 said h3 challenges the e4-knight and wrote e3-e4 with the e-pawn still on e2; plan 3 castled without e3. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Colle: 3...Bf5, Alekhine Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 claimed an open g-file after an exchange on f5; plan 3 put ...exf5 in a Black plan before White's capture; plan 4 manoeuvred a knight to e5 that is one move away. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Colle: 3...c5 4.c3
pages.notes: Overview called the line a transposition to the Semi-Slav Defence (it is White's Semi-Slav set-up with colours reversed); plan 1 used Re1 without castling. British spelling.

pages.name: Colle: 3...c5 4.c3 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the queen's knight on a d2-f1-g3 route as if already on d2 and uncastled Re1; plan 4 called d4 a target after ...cxd4 although c3 supports it. Rewrote plans 3-4; notation (0-0) and British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Colle: 3...c5 4.c3 Nc6
pages.notes: Overview called the structure Semi-Slav-like without saying colours are reversed; plan 1 developed the c1-bishop to b2 behind the c3-pawn; plan 2 wrote ...b5-b4 after ...Qb6 had blocked b6 and called it a minority attack. Rewrote all. British spelling.

pages.name: Colle: 3...g6
pages.notes: Plan 3 was vague; plan 4 named White's e4 in a Black plan. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Colle System, Grünfeld Formation
pages.notes: Plan 2 called ...c5 solidifying and named White's e4 in a Black plan; plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight to e1 or h2 for an f-pawn push the Colle does not use. Rewrote plans 2-3; notation and British spelling.

pages.name: Colle: 3...e6 4.Nbd2
pages.notes: Plan 2 gave an Re1-e3-g3 rook lift with the e3-pawn in the way; plan 1 referred to a Bd3 not yet played. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Colle: 5.c3 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 3 named ...dxe4 before White's e4; plan 4 wrote the c3-d4 chain and ...b5-b4 as routes. Rewrote plans 3-4; notation and British spelling.
